create_document_converter: create a DocumentConverter instance with allowed formats and custom format options for document conversion
convert_pdf_document: convert a single PDF file to Docling format using DocumentConverter.convert with path and page range
convert_multiple_documents: convert multiple documents from an iterable of paths using DocumentConverter.convert_all
configure_format_options: configure PdfFormatOption and WordFormatOption with custom pipeline options for specific document formats
initialize_pipeline: initialize the conversion pipeline for a selected InputFormat using DocumentConverter.initialize_pipeline
